title: 出口单证批次编号冲突与证据链核验
english: Export document lot mismatch and evidence-chain verification

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 6分钟：先慢读，再正常语速连读，重点区分 documentary 与 document。
lines: Documentary evidence
书面证据
Certificate of origin
原产地证明
Beneficial ownership
实际受益所有权
Consignment
托运批次
Reconciliation
核对
Discrepancy notice
差异通知

modules.title: 10个高频词组
modules.hint: 8分钟：每个词组造一个与矿业业务有关的完整句子。
lines: Origin declaration
原产地声明
Chain-of-custody record
交接链记录
Export permit
出口许可证
Consignee
收货人
Third-party verification
第三方核验
Supporting evidence
支持性证据
Document hold
单证暂停处理
Corrective action
纠正措施
Audit trail
审计轨迹
Conditional release
附条件放行

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 8分钟：分别练习礼貌请求、明确拒绝和承诺下一步。
lines: We need to reconcile the origin declaration with the traceability records.
我们需要将原产地声明与溯源记录核对。
The exporter and consignee names must match the approved documents.
出口商和收货人名称必须与批准文件一致。
Please explain why the shipment reference has changed.
请解释为何货运参考编号发生变化。
A verbal assurance is not sufficient for compliance clearance.
口头保证不足以取得合规放行。
We will preserve the original documents and record every amendment.
我们将保存原始文件并记录每次修改。
Do not backdate the certificate or alter the loading record.
不要倒签证明或篡改装货记录。
Can you provide a signed correction request?
你能提供签署的更正申请吗？
The bank review is separate from customs clearance.
银行审核与海关放行是两项独立程序。
We can propose a revised dispatch schedule after verification.
核验后我们可以提出调整后的发运计划。
Please confirm the responsible person and deadline in writing.
请书面确认责任人及截止时间。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 7分钟：全部为虚构教学数据；朗读数字、计算并复述单位。
lines: The simulated gross weight is sixteen point eight metric tonnes.
模拟毛重为16.8公吨。
The recorded moisture rate is three point two percent.
记录的模拟水分率为3.2%。
The calculated dry weight is sixteen point two six two four tonnes.
计算干重为16.2624吨。
The indicative tin grade is sixty-one point five percent.
模拟锡品位为61.5%。
The training unit price is twelve thousand five hundred dollars per dry tonne.
教学假设单价为每干吨12500美元。
The illustrative invoice amount is two hundred and three thousand two hundred and eighty dollars.
按上述干重和单价计算，模拟发票金额为203280美元。
The assumed exchange rate is one dollar to one thousand five hundred Rwandan francs.
假设汇率为1美元兑1500卢旺达法郎。
At that assumed rate, the invoice equals three hundred and four million nine hundred and twenty thousand francs.
按假设汇率，发票折合304920000卢旺达法郎。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 5分钟：逐句跟读五遍，最后不看中文连续复述。
lines: We have detected a mismatch between the export permit reference and the packing list.
我们发现出口许可证编号与装箱单不一致。
The shipment remains secured while our team verifies the original documents.
核验原始文件期间，货物继续安全封存。
We will notify the buyer, customs agent, and compliance officer of the revised timeline.
我们将通知买方、报关代理及合规负责人新的时间安排。
No one may change the origin declaration without supporting evidence and proper authorization.
没有支持证据和适当授权，任何人不得修改原产地声明。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 3分钟：练习从寒暄自然转入正式单证问题。
lines: Good morning. How was your trip to the warehouse?
早上好，去仓库一路顺利吗？
It went well, although the road was busy near the checkpoint.
还不错，不过检查站附近道路拥堵。
Would you like some water before we review the documents?
核对文件前要喝点水吗？
Thank you. Let's start with the packing list and permit reference.
谢谢，我们先核对装箱单和许可证编号吧。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 7分钟：分别扮演采购、合规和买方；每轮提出证据和决策标准。
lines: The supplier says the lot was sourced from an approved site, but the supporting origin record is missing.
供应商称货物来自获批矿点，但缺少原产地支持记录。
We must request the missing traceability evidence before making any origin claim.
提出原产地声明前必须索取缺失的溯源证据。
The assay certificate refers to lot A, while the invoice refers to lot B.
化验报告对应A批次，而发票对应B批次。
We should reconcile the lot identifiers and retain both versions in the audit file.
我们应核对批次标识，并在审计档案中保留两个版本。
If the buyer challenges the grade, propose a jointly witnessed sample check rather than an unsupported price concession.
如果买方质疑品位，应建议双方见证复检，而非无依据让价。
A changed beneficiary requires independent verification through an established contact channel.
收款人发生变更时，必须通过既有联系渠道独立核验。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 6分钟：模拟押运员向物流主管报告异常，并区分封签、重量和单证。
lines: The truck is waiting at the secure loading yard.
卡车正在安全装货区等待。
The container seal is intact, but the seal number differs from the dispatch sheet.
集装箱封签完好，但封签号与发运单不一致。
Photograph the seal and preserve the original dispatch sheet.
拍摄封签并保存原始发运单。
Do not open the container without written authorization and appropriate witnesses.
未经书面授权及适当见证，不得开箱。
The customs agent must not submit an unverified origin statement.
报关代理不得提交未经核验的原产地声明。
Record the reason for delay in the escort log and notify the consignee.
在押运日志中记录延误原因并通知收货人。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：每轮5分钟；先说决定，再说明理由、证据与下一步。
lines: Decision one: The buyer demands release within ten minutes despite the missing origin record.
决策一：原产地记录缺失，买方仍要求十分钟内放行。
Model answer: I understand the urgency, but we cannot release this lot until the origin evidence is verified. I will give you a documented update within thirty minutes.
示范：我理解紧迫性，但原产地证据核实前不能放行。我将在三十分钟内提供书面进展。
Decision two: The supplier asks you to change the invoice lot number without retaining the original.
决策二：供应商要求更改发票批次号且不保留原件。
Model answer: We can process a justified correction, but we must retain the original invoice, the signed request, and an audit trail.
示范：有依据的更正可以办理，但必须保留原发票、签署的申请及审计轨迹。
Decision three: The bank requests beneficiary verification while the truck driver threatens to leave.
决策三：银行要求核验收款人，同时司机威胁离场。
Model answer: Payment verification and physical dispatch are separate controls. Please keep the truck secure while finance independently confirms the beneficiary.
示范：付款核验与实物发运是独立控制。请确保车辆安全停放，财务将独立确认收款人。
Follow-up challenge: The customs agent offers to backdate a certificate to save the shipment.
追加压力：报关代理建议倒签证明以挽救发运。
Model answer: We cannot backdate records. Please prepare an accurate correction and a revised dispatch plan.
示范：我们不能倒签记录。请准备真实的更正文件及调整后的发运计划。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 3分钟：先听或读三遍，遮住英文默写，检查拼写。
lines: The origin declaration needs supporting evidence.
原产地声明需要支持性证据。
Please retain the original packing list.
请保留原始装箱单。
The seal number does not match the dispatch record.
封签号与发运记录不一致。
We cannot backdate the certificate.
我们不能倒签证明。
The beneficiary must be verified independently.
收款人必须经过独立核验。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 3分钟：每题至少回答三句，包含决定、理由和后续行动。
lines: What would you do if the export permit and packing list showed different lot numbers?
出口许可证和装箱单批次号不同，你会怎么做？
How would you explain a dispatch delay to an impatient buyer?
你会如何向不耐烦的买方解释发运延误？
Why must an original invoice be retained after correction?
更正后为什么必须保留原发票？
How would you respond to a request to backdate an origin certificate?
有人要求倒签原产地证明，你会如何回应？
How do you separate payment approval from physical release?
你如何区分付款审批与实物放行？

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.hint: 2分钟：复述最近三课的核心控制点，并与今天的单证核验衔接。
lines: Day thirty-three: Moisture disputes require documented sampling and conditional acceptance.
第33课：水分争议需要留痕取样和附条件验收。
Day thirty-four: Weight differences require original weighbridge evidence.
第34课：重量差异需要原始地磅证据。
Day thirty-five: Beneficiary changes require independent KYC verification.
第35课：收款人变更需要独立KYC核验。
Today we combine these controls into a defensible export-document decision.
今天我们将这些控制结合成可追溯的出口单证决策。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 2分钟：完整朗读并录音，目标逻辑清楚、语速稳定。
lines: Good morning. I would like to brief the team on a document discrepancy affecting our simulated mineral export shipment.
早上好，我想汇报一票模拟矿产品出口货物的单证差异。
The export permit, packing list, and assay certificate contain inconsistent lot references.
出口许可证、装箱单及化验报告的批次编号不一致。
The container is secured, and the escort officer has recorded the seal and location.
集装箱已安全封存，押运员已记录封签和位置。
We have requested the original records and a signed explanation from the supplier.
我们已向供应商索取原始记录和签署的说明。
We will not alter historical documents or release the shipment based on verbal assurances.
我们不会篡改历史文件，也不会仅凭口头保证放货。
Finance will independently verify any changed beneficiary before payment approval.
财务将在付款审批前独立核验任何变更后的收款人。
Once compliance and logistics complete their checks, we will issue a written decision and updated dispatch schedule.
合规和物流核验完成后，我们将发出书面决定和更新后的发运计划。
Thank you. Please send all supporting evidence through the approved channel.
谢谢，请通过批准的渠道提交全部支持证据。

我口述了全部模拟金额、重量、品位和汇率。
I completed the fifteen-minute role-play and three pressure decisions.
我完成了十五分钟角色扮演和三项高压决策。
I completed dictation, speaking questions, review, and the final briefing.
我完成了听写、口语题、复习和完整陈述。
